# Formules en texte brut

Suites : $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$, $u_{n+1} = \frac{u_n}{2} + 1$, $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$, $x^{2n}$, $10^{-3}$, $a_{ij}$.

Analyse : $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1$, $f'(x)$, $f''(x)$, $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$, $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$, $\sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k} = 2^n$.

Fractions : $\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}$, $\frac{1}{f(x)}$, $\frac{b-a}{n}$, $\frac{dy}{dx}$, $\sqrt{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\sqrt[3]{x}$, $\sqrt[5]{x+1}$.

Notations : $\|x\|$, $|x - 1|$, $\{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x > 0\}$, $\langle u, v \rangle$, $\lfloor x \rfloor$, $\overline{z}$, $\vec{u}$, $\overrightarrow{AB}$, $\hat{\theta}$, $x^\circ$, $A^{-1}$, $A^\top$.

Logique : $\forall \varepsilon > 0, \exists N \in \mathbb{N}$, $p \Rightarrow q$, $\neg p$, $a \equiv 1 \pmod{n}$.

Nombres : $\sqrt{2} \approx 1{,}414$, $f(1,2)$, $3 \times 4 \div 2$, $-x$, $+\infty$, $n \to +\infty$.

$$A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}, \quad \det(A) = -2.$$

$$f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{si } x \geq 0 \\ -x & \text{sinon} \end{cases}$$

$$\begin{aligned} (a+b)^2 &= a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \\ &\geq 4ab \end{aligned}$$

*Théorème. Si $f$ est continue, alors $$\int_0^1 f'(t)\,dt = f(1) - f(0).$$ C'est tout.*
